title: This Animal's Bright Blue Blood Tests Every Vaccine. It Predates Dinosaurs

scenes.text: This animal's blue blood tests your vaccines for danger.
It's the horseshoe crab, about 450 million years old.
That makes it older than the dinosaurs.
Its blood cells clot around toxic bacteria to protect it.
Scientists turned that into a test, used worldwide since the 1970s.
Thousands are bled every year, so a synthetic test is replacing them.

description:
This animal's blue blood tests your vaccines for danger.
Horseshoe crab blood clots around toxic bacteria, and the test made from it has been used worldwide since the 1970s.
Should we keep using animals for medicine tests?
